expert_search_strategy_decision_before_r.next_search_hypothesis: The iter_001 reward design has good action coverage (uses actions 1,2,3) and progress-delta guidance, but the success bonus fires in non-terminal states (proxy-success farming) and the crash penalty heuristic misclassifies normal flight as crashes. The next edit should: (1) Fix the crash penalty to only apply on actual environment termination (game_over or out-of-bounds), not on leg contact state during flight. (2) Make the success bonus truly terminal-aligned: only pay when the episode terminates with both legs contact, near pad (distance < 0.15), low vertical speed (abs(vy) < 0.5), and upright (abs(angle) < 0.2). Use a success_flag to ensure one-shot payment. (3) Keep the progress-delta reward (capped at +5 per step) and near-pad bonus (+1.0 when distance < 0.3 and abs(vy) < 0.5) as non-terminal guidance. (4) Increase main engine bonus to +0.5 when distance > 0.5 to provide meaningful incentive for approaching the pad. (5) Add diagnostics for success_flag and objective_bonus to enable post-training audits. The expected behavior change is: success_like_terminal_rate increases from 0.0 to >0.0, unsafe_terminal_rate decreases from 1.0 to <1.0, and the success bonus becomes a one-shot terminal event (success_flag_mean <= 1.2).
expert_search_strategy_decision_before_r.strategy_rationale: No candidate has achieved target behavior (success_like_terminal_rate > 0). The best candidate is iter_001, which has good action coverage and improved fitness but suffers from proxy-success farming and a flawed crash penalty. The two children (iter_002, iter_003) both regressed: iter_002 removed all non-terminal positive incentives, causing loss of approach guidance; iter_003 kept the flawed crash heuristic. The next edit should start from iter_001 and fix both flaws while preserving the progress-delta guidance and near-pad bonus. The bootstrap candidate (single_chain_iter0) is closed as it has no target behavior signal. The iter_001 family is the only promising branch.
